info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Corporate Action Review Submission API
info.description: The Corporate Action Review Submission API facilitates the posting of reviews related to various corporate actions within the banking sector. This endpoint allows financial institutions and corporate users to submit valuable feedback on market operations and corporate actions, enhancing decision-making and operational efficiency. Typical consumers include financial analysts, corporate governance teams, and compliance officers who utilize this service to ensure transparency and accountability in corporate actions. Utilizing this API helps improve the overall review process by capturing essential insights from stakeholders.

post.summary: Create a review for a corporate action.
post.description: This operation allows users to submit a review for a specific corporate action identified by its unique reference. Users can provide feedback and insights, contributing to the overall evaluation of the corporate action process.

requestBody.description: Submits a review for the specified corporate action. This operation allows users to provide feedback or comments regarding the corporate action identified by RES-100045.
